tips.text: Skip Old Mate and the heists; Little Duck sells the Repellers at Vox Solaris Rank 3, which needs no Solaris United standing.
Run the orb fights, Exploiter first, as soon as you can reach them; grind Narmer bounties and Toroid areas until then.
Buy Hildryn's blueprint and the Amp parts on the way up; it is the same standing.
Expect the Vox Solaris Toroid grind, not the build, to be the pain; it is widely disliked.
